C57 moved 0.10 mm west and 0.20 mm north to shorten RP core LX to 1.804 mm and allow a component-face connection.
D10 moved beside boost bulk and U4. Principal supply path is 10.702 mm; the old-position straight-line lower bound was 34.433 mm.
U14 pin2 laser centre is 0.025 mm south of the triangular pad centre. Hole-to-other-copper clearance is 0.18465 mm; copper clearance is 0.10965 mm. No footprint move.
ESP VTX DATA and CS laser lands use empty under-package space to avoid gyro CS and INT routing on In1. All normal drill/copper/mask limits remain.
Full In1/In4 GND zones supplement higher-priority local references. In2 remains continuous GND; In3 carries the battery plane.
